name: MobileAgentBench
description: MobileAgentBench is an efficient and user-friendly benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of mobile LLM agents interacting with mobile phone GUIs. It defines 100 tasks across 10 open-source apps with multiple difficulty levels to systematically compare existing mobile agents.
reputation: A new benchmark for mobile GUI agents that is useful for systematic evaluation, but it is still emerging and not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on alleviating manual testing burden; covers multiple difficulty levels and apps.
